user.description: Choose the Midea fan to set up. Close the SmartHome app first; the fan accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the Midea fan at {address}? Close the SmartHome app first; the fan accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time.

manual_serial.title: Enter the fan's serial
manual_serial.description: The advertisement carrying the serial of {address} was not received. Run `tools/fanctl.py scan` from this project to read it and enter the 14-character value (for example 12345678FA0001).

test.description: Could not authenticate with the fan. Close the SmartHome app, move the Bluetooth adapter closer, then submit to retry.

error.invalid_serial: Expected 14 letters and digits, with the appliance type at characters 9-10.

abort.not_supported: This Midea device is not a fan.

progress.wait_serial: Waiting for the fan at {address} to broadcast its serial. This can take up to two minutes.
